youtube_title: You Won a Car in a Lucky Draw? Scam of the Week #12 #Shorts
youtube_description:
SCAM OF THE WEEK #12. A letter with a scratch card says you won a car in an online shopping lucky draw. Then a WhatsApp message asks you to pay a registration fee or tax to release it. It is a scam: pay once and they ask for more, the car never comes.
Police advice: if anyone asks for money to claim a prize, it is fraud. Don't click claim links or scan QR codes. Got scammed? Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
Source: Mumbai Police and Telangana Cyber Security Bureau warnings.
